course_name: 數位世代翻譯理論與實務
outline: This course aims to introduce various translation practices in the digital age and to familiarize students with appropriate translation methods and strategies. The topics covered in this course include translation and technology, online collaborative translation, advertising/marketing translation, tourism translation and localization. Translation exercises and authentic translation projects will be arranged throughout the course to enable students to apply their theoretical knowledge to actual translation tasks.
schedule:
Week 1 introduction
Week 2 collaborative translation and translation crowdsourcing
Week 3 Facebook Translation Project
Week 4 Wikipedia Translation (1)
Week 5 Wikipedia Translation (2)
Week 6 translation revision in online translation crowdsourcing (1)
Week 7 translation revision in online translation crowdsourcing (2)
Week 8 fansubbing (1)
Week 9 fansubbing (2)
Week 10 translation of tourist texts (1)
Week 11 translation of tourist texts (2)/ translation of advertisements (1)
Week 12 translation of advertisements (2)
Week 13 group translation tasks
Week 14 technology and translation
Week 15 video game translation (1)
Week 16 video game translation (2)
Week 17 group presentations
Week 18 final exam
assessment:
1. continuous assessment (including attendance, participation and translation homework): 25%
2. translation project: 30%
3. group translation tasks and group presentations: 25%
4. final-exam: 20%
